name: Chimney inspection and mortar assessment
note: Crumbling mortar noted in tilstandsrapport. Get a skorstensfej or murermester to inspect before first use of brændeovn. Required before Miljøstyrelsen documentation (deadline 1 March 2027).

name: Bathroom røde tilstandsrapport items — remediation
note: Review tilstandsrapport for specific røde items. Sequence after electrical is resolved — electrician may need to be in bathroom depending on defects.

name: Brændeovn documentation submission to Miljøstyrelsen
note: Legal deadline: 1 March 2027. Requires chimney inspection to be completed first. Submit via Miljøstyrelsen's online portal.

name: Rising damp — chemical injection (basement + garage)
note: Moved from Move-In 2026 (was TSK-4, Q4 2026). Revisit Q1 2027. Chemical injection recommended per tilstandsrapport. Specify in quotes: method, product, treatment depth, drying time guarantee. Sequencing constraint: must be Done and basement dry before any basement fit-out task goes In Progress. Drying time 3–6 months post-injection.

name: Basement electrical defects remediation (#10–21)
note: Blocked until damp injection is Done and basement is verified dry. Defects: missing lamp terminals (viktualierum, stort rum, fyrrum), uncovered junction boxes, loose cables, oversized box openings in værksted, bare wire connection outside box in mellemgang (#18 — fire risk). All require autoriseret elinstallatør. Can be batched with ground floor electrical scope if same contractor.

name: Garage electrical defects remediation (#22–24)
note: Defects #22–24: multiple loose cables, loose socket/plate, multiple uncovered junction boxes. Requires autoriseret elinstallatør. Can potentially be batched with ground floor or basement electrical contractor to reduce call-out costs.

name: Week 1 — Baseline photo survey (before touching anything)
note: Photograph all walls, floors, and ceilings before moving anything. Especially: behind radiators, under carpets, behind built-in wardrobes. Dated photos = baseline evidence for insurance and future contractors.

name: Week 1 — Meter readings on overtagelse day (electricity, water, heat)
note: Day one 1 Sep at 12:00: photograph electricity meter, water meter, and heat meter readings. Dated. Non-negotiable for dispute prevention with seller.

name: Week 1 — Key inventory + front door re-key
note: PRIMEIRO PASSO (dia 1/semana 1, grátis): checar se a casa já tem um sistema de chaves compartilhado. (1) testar a chave da porta da frente na porta do porão — se abrir, já estão no mesmo sistema. (2) checar a marca no rosto do cilindro (ASSA, Ruko, LAAS, Trioving, Kaba, IKON). (3) perguntar à vendedora se há um systemkort/nøglekort — juntar com #14. Se houver sistema com cartão: NÃO chamar um låsesmed genérico — só o revendedor autorizado daquela marca. Se não houver sistema: lásesmed faz "ens nøgle" para as 3 fechaduras. Preços Aros Låse (aros-laase.dk/priser, checado 02/ago): omkodning Ruko 6-stift ou Abus Zolit incl. 3 chaves = 950 kr (só se for uma dessas marcas); +300 kr por fechadura extra recodificada junto (porão + postkasse = +600 kr, SE forem recodificáveis); +60 kr por chave extra além das 3; senão, 725 kr/hora. Não cobre se precisar do serviço de systemnøgle (chave de sistema) — isso é cotado à parte. Estimativa grosseira se Ruko/Abus Zolit + ambas recodificáveis: ~1.550 kr. Provavelmente NÃO elegível a håndværkerfradrag.

name: Week 1 — Transfer utilities (fjernvarme, el, vand, internet)
note: Concluído 02/ago: luz + internet transferidos por Ariel; água + fjernvarme ficaram a cargo da vendedora. Solceller: propriedade do VE-anlæg já transferida (borger.dk). ⚠️ Isso NÃO inclui o cadastro no Vindstød (ve.vindstoed.dk) para receber o pristillæg pelo excedente — esse é um passo separado, ainda em aberto, sem tarefa própria no Notion. Seguro da casa e ejerskifteforsikring também já resolvidos (não havia tarefa específica para isso).

name: Week 1 — Collect and file seller documentation (brændeovn, solceller, permits)
note: Collect all documentation left by seller: brændeovn manual + production date (critical for Miljøstyrelsen deadline), solceller installation papers, fjernvarme service records, any permits or byggetilladelser. Store in house folder.

name: Week 1 — Sort and segregate seller leftovers (keep / give / genbrugstation / hazardous)
note: Sort all seller leftovers into 4 piles: Keep / Give away or sell / Genbrugsstation / Hazardous waste (chemicals, paint, oil, pesticides — genbrugsstationer accept these free). Do not skip segregation — mixed skips cost more and hazardous waste cannot go in the bin.

name: Week 1 — Dismantle wardrobes + inspect walls behind
note: Dismantle fixed wardrobes. Before removing: photograph wall behind. Fixings likely go into brick or hollow-block — anchors may crumble on removal. Have filler and primer ready. Check walls behind for damp staining before filling.

name: Week 1 — Remove carpets + inspect and document subfloor condition
note: Pull all carpets. Photograph subfloor immediately — 1968 construction may be concrete screed or timber boards. Check timber perimeters for rot, especially near exterior walls. Note condition before any flooring decisions are made.

name: Week 1 — Remove and give away unwanted furniture
note: Remove unwanted furniture. Coordinate with Facebook Marketplace / DBA gives in advance — post before move-in so collections happen week one. Heavy items: arrange help or hire a man-with-van for one run to Aarhus Genbrugsstation.

name: Preventive pest control — full house
note: Schedule in week 2 alongside electrical work. Must happen before walls are repainted and floors are laid — treatment is less effective once surfaces are sealed. 1968 construction: check for wood-boring insects in timber subfloor and roof structure.

name: Bathroom — regrout bathtub perimeter (røde item)
note: Tilstandsrapport røde item: defective grout around bathtub is flagged as active water damage risk. Cut out old grout with a grout saw, clean, apply new silicone sealant. Do this before plumber fits shower. DIY-eligible, approx 1–2 hours. Tools: oscillating tool or grout saw, masking tape, bathroom silicone (Mapei or Soudal).

name: Bathroom — install shower over bathtub (riser, mixer, screen)
note: Chuveiro adicionado sobre a banheira existente (banheira mantida): haste deslizante, misturador, mangueira flexível, box ou varão de cortina. Serviço de meio dia com encanador — depois do rejunte (#22). Adicionado 02/ago (nota da Natalia): avaliar o azulejo rachado no nicho do chuveiro na mesma visita — esse é o item vermelho do tilstandsrapport não relacionado à umidade ascendente.

name: Clean and stain/paint ceiling wood — all rooms
note: Sequence: after electrical is signed off, before wall painting. Ceiling work generates drips and dust — walls must not be painted yet. Clean timber with sugar soap first, allow to dry fully before staining or painting. Protect floors with dust sheets.

name: Sand and paint stair slats — basement stair entrance
note: Sand before painting entrance walls — sanding generates fine dust that settles on fresh paint. Use 80-grit then 120-grit. Prime bare wood before topcoat. Entrance area: protect floor tiles during sanding. Sequence: after ceiling work, before wall paint in entrance.

name: Consertar e pintar paredes — sala + 3º quarto (sem troca de piso/rodapé)
note: Escopo reduzido em 02/ago: cobre só sala de estar + o quarto que NÃO está tendo carpete/rodapé trocado — os outros dois quartos (principal e Olivia) agora têm tarefas próprias (#74–81), pois têm sequência diferente (piso + rodapé novo). Sequência: depois da elétrica aprovada, depois do teto (#24), depois de lixar as ripas da escada (#25). Preencher furos, lixar (Gyproc Finspackel em paredes de tijolo de 1968), mínimo duas demãos. Passagem única — sem necessidade de demão pós-piso aqui, já que este piso não está sendo trocado.

name: Clean kitchen cupboards — inside and out
note: Schedule after all dusty work is complete — sanding, wall work, ceiling. Use degreaser (Nilfisk or similar). Check inside cupboards for old food, pest evidence, or moisture. Note any hinge or door issues for later. Not sequencing-critical but do before moving kitchen contents in.

name: Balustrade — add timber cap rail (oak, clear Osmo) over white-painted rail
note: Phase 2 — do after balustrade is painted white and you've lived with it for a few weeks. Cap rail sits on top of existing horizontal rail, so no repainting needed around it. Scope: 40–50mm × 20mm planed timber strip, mitred corners, slight chamfer or roundover on top edges. Recommended: planed oak with clear Osmo Polyx 3028 satin — warm but pale, ages well. Avoid pine (yellows). Fix with Würth FIX or Sikaflex adhesive + countersunk screws from underneath. No visible fixings from above. Measure linear metres of top rail before buying timber — include mitres. Est. materials only: 300–600 kr.

name: Balustrade — paint all timber elements white (post, rails, newels)
note: All timber — no steel. Elements: large centre post, top and bottom horizontal rails, corner newel posts. White vertical slats already done or close — match sheen. Sequence: (1) clean with Allrens, (2) sand 120 then 180 grit with grain, (3) fill dents with Reparationsspartel, (4) prime bare wood with Flügger Træ Primer, (5) two coats Flügger Træ & Metal satin white NCS S 0500-N. Tools: 4cm radiator roller for flat faces, 25mm brush for slats and edges. Must do before cap rail task. Est. materials ~560 kr.

name: Paint chimney breast white
note: Varmebestandig maling (min 150°C rated) for zone closest to brændeovn, standard Flügger Flutex or Scanmix for rest. Sugar soap clean first. 18mm thick-nap roller. Two coats. Must follow chimney mortar repointing — do not paint over failing mortar.

name: Repoint chimney mortar
note: Known defect from tilstandsrapport. Must happen before chimney breast is painted and before brændeovn is used. Batch with chimney inspection (TSK-3). Ask skorstensfejler or murermester to quote both together.

name: Ceiling wood — assess and treat with Osmo
note: Bedroom ceiling has uneven staining from furniture blocking UV/oxidation. Selective colour-matching with Osmo Wood Wax Finish 3119 Quartz Grey or 3166 Teak applied with lint-free cloth to feather lighter patches. Unpainted rooms: Osmo Polyx-Oil Raw 3044. Photograph in natural daylight before buying product. After electrical remediation.

name: All radiators — check thermostatic valves fitted
note: Check all radiators have termostatventiler fitted before first winter. If missing, a VVS-mester can fit them — straightforward job. Also check radiator sizing in large living room with the big glazed windows — may underperform in winter without curtains.

name: In-ground trampoline — 380cm round
note: EXIT or Berg Toys. EN71/TÜV certified. Removable net enclosure — posts anchor to frame not ground. Budget 6,500–16,000 DKK depending on groundwater situation. Dig test hole first before committing — 1984 flood history. Mini-digger rental 1,500–2,500 kr if manual excavation not feasible. Safety pad replacement every 3–4 years, mat every 5–8 years.

name: White goods replacement — kitchen
note: Scope: fridge/freezer combo, dishwasher, built-in oven, induction hob, extractor hood. Excludes washing machine and dryer. Budget tier ~15,500 kr / Mid ~27,000 kr / Premium ~52,000 kr. Induction hob requires electrician circuit upgrade — batch with electrical contractor. Check BR18 ventilation compliance for extractor hood. Retailers: Skousen, Elgiganten, Power.

name: Humidity monitoring — basement (IKEA ALPSTUGA)
note: Blocked until electrical remediation done — ALPSTUGA is mains-only, no battery. Matter/Thread native. Requires Thread Border Router (not DIRIGERA) to function as smart device. Install in basement after electrical signed off and damp treatment underway. Use as ongoing moisture baseline tracker.

name: Smart home foundation — Matter/Thread ecosystem setup
note: Start with ALPSTUGA humidity sensors (no hub needed for monitoring). Expand to lighting and other devices once electrical is clean. No DIRIGERA hub needed in monitoring phase. Plan ecosystem before buying — Matter allows mixing brands.

name: Home alarm system
note: Wait until after electrical remediation — sensor placement conflicts with wall/ceiling work. Risskov is lower-crime postcode. Start with DIY self-monitored system (Yale or Somfy) before committing to monitored contract. Verisure ~400-500 kr/month + 3,000-4,500 kr install. G4S lower monthly, higher upfront. 5-year total cost ~27,000-30,000 kr either provider.

name: Air-to-air split unit — cooling addition to fjernvarme
note: Addition to fjernvarme, not replacement. Bidirectional — heating and cooling. After electrical remediation, damp treatment, and insulation audit complete. Sequence: electrical → damp → insulation audit → radiator assessment → split unit decision.

name: Garage roof timber — inspect and treat with linseed oil
note: Open rafter and purlin construction. Primary concern is condensation not rain. Screwdriver test on rafter ends and wall connections for rot before treating. If sound: raw or boiled linseed oil (linolie) or Osmo UV-Schutzöl — preserves natural look. One application before winter. ~300-500 kr materials. Do not paint.

name: Kitchen — on-site structural wall assessment (murermester)
note: Prerequisite for all kitchen work. Pull Henry Hass structural drawings from bygningsattest file. Have murermester or bygningskonstruktør confirm wall status on-site before any demolition. Seller's agent statement is not legally binding — confirm independently. One site visit, ~2,000–3,000 kr. Batch with chimney or electrical contractor visit if possible.

name: Kitchen — wall removal between kitchen and room
note: Demolish wall between kitchen and adjacent room. Scope depends on structural assessment. If any lintel required: steel or concrete, temporary propping during work, check if byggetilladelse needed under BR18. Batch demolition with kitchen contractor to avoid double mobilisation.

name: Kitchen — full new kitchen design and installation
note: Full new kitchen installation. Scope: design, supply, and fit. IKEA to mid-range budget. New layout TBD after wall removal. Electrician must be involved for new circuit layout — batch with kitchen wiring if possible to avoid second call-out. VVS for new plumbing positions if sink or dishwasher moves.

name: Kitchen — electrical circuit layout for new kitchen
note: New kitchen circuit layout — batch with electrical remediation contractor (TSK-1) if scope allows. Induction hob requires dedicated circuit. Dishwasher, fridge, and extractor hood circuits. If kitchen layout changes significantly, do not finalise remediation wiring until kitchen plan is confirmed.

name: Kitchen — VVS replumbing for new layout
note: New plumbing positions if sink or dishwasher moves in new layout. Batch with kitchen installation. Get VVS quote at same time as kitchen quote — some kitchen fitters include VVS coordination, others don't.

name: Kitchen — showroom visits (HTH, Invita, Kvik) for design + budget calibration
note: Visit HTH and Invita Aarhus showrooms for design inspiration and budget calibration. No commitment — reference only. Both offer free design consultations. Bring rough kitchen dimensions and photos of the space. Do after wall assessment confirms layout. HTH: Silkeborgvej, Aarhus. Invita: Hasselager. Kvik also worth a visit as lower-cost comparison. Decision on brand only after wall removal scope is confirmed.

name: Rental — pack boxes (non-essentials first)
note: Buy boxes by week 36. Pack non-essentials early, keep daily-use items for last. Label boxes by destination room at Enemærket 6 — saves confusion during 2–3 trip moves. Start week 37–38, finished before week 39 transport begins.

name: Rental — remove wall plugs/fixings + patch and touch up holes
note: Remove all wall plugs/sockets installed during tenancy (shelving anchors, TV mounts, curtain rail fixings etc). Fill and touch up holes with matching white paint — standard rental deposit requirement. Do this after furniture is out of the way, before final clean.

name: Rental — final clean (DIY flytterengoring)
note: DIY flytterengoring — not professional. Standard Danish rental deposit checklist: ovn, køleskab, badeværelse (kalk, fuger), vinduer indvendigt, skårt, gulve. Budget a full day, ideally with two people. Do after all furniture and boxes are out. Photograph finished result room by room for deposit dispute protection.

name: Book van/truck rental by week 34 — dates TBD, execution week 39
note: Booking deadline: week 34 (early booking to secure availability — September is high-demand moving month in Denmark). Specific rental dates within week 39 still TBD. 2–3 trips over several days rather than one big day. Options: GreenMobility, Sixt, Europcar van rental, or Fragtmand for larger furniture if a van is impractical. Confirm van/truck size needed based on furniture inventory.

name: Rental — confirm fraflytningssyn (handover inspection) date with landlord
note: Confirm with landlord/udlejer: exact handover date and time, deposit return process and timeline, final meter readings required, any pre-handover inspection scheduled. Danish rental norm is usually a joint inspection (fraflytningssyn) — book this in advance, don't assume it's automatic.

name: Electrical — pre-align calls with 5–6 electricians
note: Comprimido 02/ago a pedido da Natalia: escolher e agendar precisa caber 3–7/ago. Ligar para 5–6 eletricistas, enviar o elinstallationsrapport antes.

name: Electrical — site visits + firm quotes (3 companies)
note: ⚠️ Comprimido 02/ago para caber antes de 7/ago — mas isso significa visita técnica dos eletricistas ANTES da entrega das chaves (1/set). Precisa de permissão da vendedora para acesso pré-entrega, o que ainda não foi confirmado com ela. Sem essa permissão, esta tarefa não é executável nessas datas.

name: Electrical — select contractor and book
note: Select contractor from the 3 firm quotes and book immediately — no gap between decision and booking. Confirm start date fits within week 37–39 execution window.

name: Electrical — remediation work executed
note: Fundida em 02/ago com #1 e #20. Compressão de cronograma em 02/ago: início 11/set (dado por Ariel). Prazo 16/set é INFERÊncia minha — Ariel não deu data final para #58, só para #65 (que roda no mesmo período/orçamento). Assumi que o trabalho principal termina junto com #65. Confirmar se está certo. Correção completa dos 24 defeitos do elinstallationsrapport, incl. risco de incêndio. Empreiteiro emite fejlrettelseserklæring ao concluir.

name: Electrical — fallback decision checkpoint (fire-risk-only scope)
note: Checkpoint, not a work task. If full 24-defect remediation is at risk of slipping past week 41, decide NOW (not week 40) to prioritise closing only the fire-risk items: #1–4 exterior spots (uninspected) and #18 bare wire in mellemgang. Deciding late leaves no time to re-scope with the contractor.

name: Bathroom — remove grey storage cabinet
note: Check what's behind/inside it first (isolation valves, old pipework, service panel) before removing — the photo shows no visible plumbing but confirm on site. If wall-mounted, unscrew from wall brackets; if freestanding, just lift out. Do this before the shower fit and before repainting the under-sink cabinet, so the room is clear.

name: Bathroom — install unheated towel ladder/rail
note: Decorative/unheated rail only — not plumbed into heating. Drill into blue tile: needs a tile-rated masonry bit (start small, step up) and wall plugs rated for tile/masonry substrate, not standard plasterboard plugs. Go slow to avoid cracking tile. Do after the grey cabinet is removed, so placement isn't blocked by it.

name: Bathroom — replace lighting above mirror
note: Professional only — this is a våderum (wet room) under BR18, and any new electrical work here has strict zone rules for fixture placement relative to water sources. Must be done by an autoriseret elinstallør regardless of how simple the swap looks. Bundle into the same electrical remediation quote/booking process rather than treating as a separate job — ask the same electrician for a price on this while they're already quoting the 24-defect remediation.

name: Bathroom — paint under-sink cabinet white/light
note: Cabinet is almost certainly laminated/foil-wrapped, not raw wood — normal paint will peel within months without correct prep. Sequence: degrease surface, sand with fine grit (320+) to key it, apply a bonding primer made for laminate/melamine (e.g. Bondex or Zinsser equivalent, available at Silvan/Bauhaus), then 2 coats of a durable furniture-grade paint in white or light colour. Skipping the bonding primer is the most common failure mode. Do after the grey cabinet is removed and before the shower fit, to avoid overspray/splash risk on wet fresh paint.

name: Electrical — walk ground floor, map outlet needs (all rooms)
note: ⚠️ Movido para antes da visita, agora 3/ago. Mesmo problema de #56: mapear tomadas exige caminhar pela casa, o que exige acesso pré-entrega (não confirmado com a vendedora). Se não houver acesso, isso vira uma ligação/pergunta ao invés de visita presencial.

name: Electrical — add/relocate outlets, ground floor (per walkthrough)
note: Must be priced and scheduled as part of the same week-36 quote as the 24-defect remediation and bathroom light — not a separate later call-out. Hard sequencing constraint: any new/moved outlets require chasing into walls or surface conduit, and this MUST happen before wall fill + paint (renovation step 6). If this isn't bundled into the same site visit, you risk repainting walls that then need to be cut into again.

name: Bathroom — measure basement vanity, check fit for ground-floor swap
note: Basement bathroom has a white gloss wall-mounted vanity with integrated basin, two drawers. Measure its width, depth, and plumbing centreline (water inlet + waste position) and compare against the ground-floor sink opening. If it fits (or fits with minor plumbing adjustment), swap it in instead of repainting the black under-sink cabinet — skip the paint job. Blocked from physically doing the swap until basement damp remediation is complete, but the measurement itself can happen anytime you're in the basement (photograph/measure only, no removal yet).

name: Front hedge repair: post-move inspection + hybrid privet plan
Macieira — primeira poda de renovação (inverno)
note: Dividido em 02/ago (nota da Natalia distinguiu as duas etapas): a checagem de frutos/folhas foi para uma tarefa nova (setembro 2026, ver tarefa separada) porque faz sentido observar a fruta/folhagem ainda na árvore no outono, não esperar até 2027. A poda de renovação em si continua aqui, no inverno (época de dormu00eancia), Q1 2027.

name: Cherry tree feature: mulch ring + uplighting
Greenhouse: clear clutter + inspect glazing/vents/seals
Pressure wash patio/walkway paving (moss/algae)
Garage floor epoxy — evaluate post-moisture-remediation
note: Blocked — pending garage moisture verification, not calendar-scheduled. Trigger: chemical injection complete → 12–24mo drying → moisture readings confirm equilibrium in garage specifically. Epoxy is vapour-impermeable; applying to a still-wicking slab causes delamination or pushes moisture elsewhere. When unblocked, alternatives: breathable floor paint (diffusionsåben betonmaling, Jotun/Flügger) or no treatment pending readings.

name: Bomba d'água — localizar, verificar funcionamento, aprender a operar (dia 1)
note: Escopo do dia 1, restrito: localizar a bomba no bru00f8nd do lado norte, confirmar se está ligada/funcionando (escutar o motor), e aprender como operar/resetar manualmente, se der. NENHUMA chamada a profissional no dia 1, mesmo que a bomba pareça com problema — só anotar o que foi observado. A inspeção completa (limpeza, troca de sensor/válvula se preciso, teste do dreno) vai para a #82, em outro dia da semana 1. ⚠️ Isso diverge da recomendação da Natalia de chamar um VVS-mester imediatamente se a bomba estiver silenciosa/travada — decisão do Ariel de adiar essa ligação para depois do dia 1.

name: Quarto principal — escaneamento de umidade + avaliação da base do piso
note: Substitui parte da #34 (dividida em 02/ago). Medir a profundidade do rebaixo com o Laserliner DampFinder antes de comprar material. Fórmula: profundidade do rebaixo − 18mm (piso engenheirado) − 2mm (dampspærre PE-folie) = espessura máxima de XPS. Não depende da elétrica — pode ser feito logo após remover o carpete (#18).

name: Quarto da Olivia — escaneamento de umidade + avaliação da base do piso
note: Substitui parte da #34 (dividida em 02/ago). Medir separadamente do quarto principal — não presumir mesma profundidade. Não depende da elétrica — pode ser feito logo após remover o carpete (#18).

name: Quarto principal — remover rodapé antigo + preparo de parede + 1ª demão
note: Decisão confirmada 02/ago: rodapé será trocado (estado ruim pelas fotos). Remover rodapé antigo ANTES do preparo de parede — não depois. Preencher furos, lixar, primer, 1ª demão completa. Depende de elétrica (#58) e teto (#24) concluídos. ⚠️ Data estimada — assume elétrica concluída ~1 semana antes do prazo atual de #58 (4/out). Se a elétrica atrasar até 4/out, esta tarefa e as seguintes (#77–81) empurram para depois da semana 41 (viagem EMBA).

name: Quarto da Olivia — remover rodapé antigo + preparo de parede + 1ª demão
note: Sequencial após #76 (mesma equipe fazendo um quarto por vez) — pode ser paralelo se houver duas pessoas trabalhando. ⚠️ Data estimada, mesma ressalva de #76: depende da elétrica não atrasar até seu prazo atual (4/out).

name: Quarto principal — instalar piso clicado
note: Substitui parte da #28 (dividida em 02/ago). Corrigido de Profissional para DIY, conforme decisão da família. Vão de dilatação de 10–15mm em todo o perímetro (coberto depois pelo rodapé). Proteger a parede já pintada com fita crepe durante a instalação. Depende da 1ª demão (#76) estar seca (mín. 24–48h).

name: Quarto da Olivia — instalar piso clicado
note: Substitui parte da #28 (dividida em 02/ago). Corrigido de Profissional para DIY. Mesmas regras de vão de dilatação e proteção da parede que #78. Depende da 1ª demão (#77) estar seca.

name: Quarto principal — instalar rodapé novo + demão final
note: Fixar o rodapé NA PAREDE, nunca no piso — o piso flutuante precisa poder se mover; rodapé pregado no piso pode causar empeno. Demão final cobre marcas da instalação do piso/rodapé; corte fino na linha superior do rodapé. Custo do rodapé: 40–80 DKK/metro linear — medir o perímetro do quarto para orçar.

name: Quarto da Olivia — instalar rodapé novo + demão final
note: Fixar o rodapé NA PAREDE, nunca no piso — o piso flutuante precisa poder se mover. Cronograma comprimido 02/ago junto com a elétrica: esta tarefa agora termina 24/set, quase duas semanas antes da viagem de Ariel (semana do EMBA), em vez de coincidir com ela como antes. Custo do rodapé: 40–80 DKK/metro linear.

name: Bomba d'água — inspeção completa, limpeza, reset e rotina de manutenção
note: Continuação da #73 (dia 1 foi só localizar + observar). Reset completo: puxar a bomba, limpar sedimento, checar bóia/sensor, testar válvula de retenção, confirmar o trajeto da linha de descarga — checar se conecta ao sistema de dreno de 2017 (B.S. Kristiansen), rodar teste manual. Se não conseguir resolver sozinho (bomba não liga, sensor não responde), aí sim considerar chamar um VVS-mester — não é automático como a nota da Natalia sugeria, mas fica como plano B. Rotina contínua depois: testar trimestralmente, limpeza completa da caixa anualmente antes do outono. Custo estimado: 0 kr se for só limpeza; 300–800 kr se precisar trocar bóia/válvula; 1.500–3.500 kr se precisar trocar a bomba inteira.

name: Solceller — cadastro no Vindstød para pristillæg (excedente)
note: Cadastro no Vindstød (ve.vindstoed.dk) para receber o pristillæg pelo excedente de energia do sistema solar (6kWp, Afregningsgruppe 6). Separado da transferência de propriedade do VE-anlæg (essa já estava feita no borger.dk). Iniciado por Ariel em 02/ago.

name: Macieira — checagem de frutos e folhas (outono)
